description: This file defines the ContentWrapper interface, which provides methods for handling content data within the Apache OFBiz project. It includes static utility methods for retrieving default MIME types, extracting fields from model objects, and encoding content, as well as an abstract method for content retrieval.

classes.name: ContentWrapper
classes.description: Interface defining methods for content handling, including static utility functions for MIME type retrieval, field extraction, and content encoding.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve content as StringWrapper based on contentTypeId and encoderType.

methods.name: getDefaultMimeTypeId
methods.description: Returns the default MIME type ID configured in the content properties, defaulting to 'text/html; charset=utf-8' if not set.

methods.name: getCandidateFieldValue
methods.description: Overloaded method that retrieves a field value from a model object or from a model entity identified by primary key, based on contentTypeId.

methods.name: encodeContentValue
methods.description: Encodes the given content string using the specified encoder type, sanitizing or logging warnings as needed.
